e-polls.1.evidence: bob, General Discussion composer > Add Poll: question 'Which day suits the monthly community call?' with the three options, Single choice, Post Topic -> topic published; poll shows the three options 0% and '0 voters'.

e-polls.2.evidence: question + one option, Post Topic -> 'Question and at least 2 options required.', stays on /new/, no topic created.

e-polls.3.evidence: blank 2nd option -> 400 'A poll requires at least 2 non-empty options.'; question 501 chars -> 400 'Poll question must be 500 characters or fewer.'; option 256 chars -> 400 'Poll option must be 255 characters or fewer.'; closes_at 'not-a-date' -> 400 'Invalid close date format.'.

e-polls.4.evidence: POST /posts/13826/poll again -> 409 jetonomy_duplicate 'This topic already has a poll.'; page still shows one poll.

e-polls.5.evidence: alice clicked 'Thursday 09:00 UTC': that option 100% (full bar), '1 voter', her option checked.

e-polls.6.evidence: alice clicked Tuesday: Thursday 0%, Tuesday 100%, still '1 voter'.

e-polls.7.evidence: alice DELETE /polls/30/vote -> 200 counts back to 0; second DELETE -> 404 'No vote found to remove.'.

e-polls.8.evidence: maya on a Multiple choice poll (votes submit on each tick, there is no Submit button): ticking two options -> each +1 (88:1, 89:1, 1 voter); unticking all -> 0/0/0, 0 voters, never negative.

e-polls.9.evidence: two option_ids on a single poll -> 400 'This poll allows only one choice.'; option 88 of another poll -> 400 'Option 88 does not belong to this poll.'; no option -> 400 'At least one option is required.'.

e-polls.10.evidence: double-click on 'Saturday 15:00 UTC' as maya -> that option 1 vote, 1 voter, 100% (percentages sum to 100).

e-polls.11.evidence: closes_at in the past: UI shows closed; POST vote -> 403 jetonomy_closed 'This poll has closed.'; DELETE vote -> 403 'This poll has closed. Votes cannot be changed.'; results still readable.

e-polls.12.evidence: PATCH /polls/30 closes_at 2020-01-01 -> closed true (GET and the page agree at once); PATCH {closed:false} alone changes nothing (still true); PATCH closes_at '' -> closed false, closes_at null.

e-polls.13.evidence: alice POST /posts/13750/poll -> 403 'You do not have permission to create a poll on this topic.'; PATCH /polls/30 -> 403 'You do not have permission to modify this poll.'; test_moderator PATCH -> 200 (space_admin not separately run).

e-polls.14.evidence: guest: results visible, options disabled with 'Log in to vote.' under the poll; POST /polls/30/vote -> 401.

e-polls.15.evidence: bob POST /polls/10/vote and GET /posts/403/poll (Customer Advisory Board) -> 404 'Poll not found.' / 'No poll found for this topic.', identical to a missing id; guest GET -> 404, guest vote -> 401.

e-polls.16.evidence: finn POST /polls/30/vote -> 403 jetonomy_user_silenced 'Your account is currently silenced and cannot post.'

e-polls.17.evidence: omar POST vote on a poll in an Off-Topic Lounge topic (banned) -> 404 'Poll not found.' (his GET too); count unchanged.

e-polls.18.evidence: 480-char question + 250-char option at 390px on Reign: poll card inside the viewport, no overflowing child, no horizontal scroll; Arabic poll question and options compute rtl, start-aligned.

e-polls.19.evidence: wp-admin Jetonomy > Polls lists question and topic title per row (no 'Post #id'), 20 per page, '29 polls 1 2 >' pager; a poll whose topic was deleted shows '—' in the topic column, no fatal.

e-polls.20.evidence: before voting, maya and the guest see percentages (0%) on the poll; after voting maya's choices are checked/marked.

e-polls.21.evidence: single-choice vote: count and total +1; changing vote moves one from old to new, total unchanged (alice Thursday -> Tuesday, 1 voter).
